hookups.source: Olmsted County camping page, Oxbow Park ('42 electric sites and four camper cabins, water hookup'; 'Campers are allowed to stay hooked up to the water source as long as there is a backflow preventer on the spigot'), read 2026-11-11. Amperage not stated.

sites.source: Olmsted County camping page ('Amenities include: 42 electric sites and four camper cabins ... two host sites'; campground rules: 'All campsites are back-in-sites only'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Shower/restroom building and dump station closed in winter; non-campers pay $15 to dump.

facilities.source: Olmsted County camping page, Oxbow Park ('large restroom facility and two vault toilets, wifi'; 'dump station'; 'Shower/restroom building will NOT be open during the winter camping season'; 'Potable water is available at the Nature Center and Campground'; 'Unregistered campers may use the dump station for a $15 fee'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Open all year except April (repairs and water-line start-up); in winter only sites 10, 11, 13, 15 and 16 and the camper cabins.

season.source: Olmsted County camping page ('Oxbow Park's NEW campground has select campsites and camper cabins available year-round, with the exception of April for annual maintenance'; 'Campsites 10,11,13,15 and 16 and all 4 camper cabins will be available year-round except for the month of April'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: County ResNexus site. Up to six months ahead; reservations non-transferable. Ten consecutive nights at most, then 24 hours away. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: Olmsted County camping page ('Reserve a campsite at Oxbow Park'; 'three-night minimum on holiday weekends; two-night minimum on weekends; one-night minimum Sunday - Thursday'; 'Reservations can be made up to six months prior to your arrival date'; 'site occupancy limited to 10 (ten) consecutive days'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Olmsted County: $35 a night for an electric campsite (every Oxbow site is electric), the same in winter; camper cabin $75. Read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: Olmsted County camping page, Oxbow Park ('Cost $35 per night for campsites with electricity'; 'Pricing remains the same as the regular season'), read 2026-11-11

note: Olmsted County park near Byron; the rebuilt campground is a short walk from the nature center, Zollman Zoo and a large playground. A youth-group camp lies elsewhere in the park. --Claude
summary: County camping page read: new campground with 42 electric back-in sites + 4 cabins, water hookup, showers, vault toilets, dump, wifi, $35 a night; open all year except April (5 sites in winter); 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 6-month window, 10-night max, ResNexus booking.
